text: This app is great! It's really simple but so cute. 🦥 I can find everything I need in here and don't waste time trying to navigate through a forrest of features that I don't really even use.
author: Kateřina Vokálová
developer_reply: Thank you for your wonderful feedback! We’re thrilled to hear that you find Habitive simple and easy to use. We believe in keeping things clean and intuitive, so it’s great to know that you appreciate it. 🦥🧡
